seed_comment:
Forgot to mention — the function was called `processThings`. It did nine things. None of them were called `processThings`.

Every time someone new joined the team, that function was the first thing they asked about.

Naming things is hard. Naming a nine-headed monster honestly is even harder.

Who's got a worse one? 👇
